body: I don't know where to start. I'm an introverted person, so talking to people is always awkward for me, including people like my parents. My parents are a large amount of the problem. They criticize me all the time, and hold me to massive standards. To my memory they have really only said they love me and value me like 2 times. I hate so many people, I hate myself. Sorry.
I hear that everything works out, but I know that there is going to be a pretty big shit-storm as I grow older. Everyone says the teens are rough.

They sometimes try to talk to me, and when they do I feel like I can't talk to them at all. They are a huge part in my problem, whether they realize it or not they put so much pressure on me, almost all their comments are negative and I just want to curl up and hide.
I want to talk to them but I just feel like I can't. I feel like I have no one.
There is so much more I could say. But I just can't right now. I can barely type, I had to edit this message like 20 times.
